name: btx-skill-jev
description: Hand a bounded judgment repeated over many items (label, triage, match, score, yes/no) to TypeSafe's Jev from a tested script instead of reading every item into context or looping an LLM per item. Ships the jev-judge skill and its uv-run batch jig: redaction before sending, a request-rate limit, rate-limit retries, a pilot mode and a flat-question check.
